channel.title: Go Humble! RSS Books
channel.description: Awesome RSS Feeds about HumbleBundle books bundles!

item.title: GenAI & Agentic AI by BPB
item.content:encoded: Be on the cutting edge of the new technological frontier with this bundle of instructional ebooks and training manuals all about generative and agentic AI! Learn how to scale genAI models with Kubernetes and LangChain, discover practical real-world approaches to using agentic AI and autonomous systems, and find out how to build them yourself to suit your needs! Learn how AI works from the inside so you can use it to optimize just about everything. Pay what you want for this bundle of 17 ebooks about everything AI, and support regenerative agriculture charity Kiss the Ground with your purchase!

item.title: African Futurism: Nnedi Okorafor, Wole Talabi, and Adam Oyebanji by DAW Books
item.content:encoded: Explore daring, futuristic science fiction like you’ve never seen it before with this bundle of African-inspired novels and short story collections from Nnedi Okorafor, Wole Talabi, and Adam Oyebanji! Learn the secrets of an interspecies conflict through the eyes of a young astronaut in Okorafor’s Binti: The Complete Trilogy! Solve an impossible crime in Oyebanji’s genre-blending mystery Esperance! Follow a man with electric skin, a woman trying to save her brother from Mars, an engineer troubleshooting a malfunctioning AI, and more in Talabi’s short story collection Convergence Problems! All of these and more ebooks are included in this bundle, proving that the realms of Africanfuturism have never been more thrilling. Get them now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

item.title: Excel by Wiley
item.content:encoded: Ready to woo your team with the sharpest Excel skills in the office? We’ve got you covered with an approachable bundle of ebooks on Excel and the greater Microsoft 365 suite! Jam‑packed with titles from the iconic For Dummies series like Microsoft 365 Excel Formulas & Functions For Dummies, 7th Edition and Excel Data Analysis For Dummies, 5th Edition, this amazing bundle by Wiley covers a wide range of beginner and intermediate topics to help meet you at your existing skill level. Experience Excel’s everyday power of simple data organization, powerful calculations, and more while helping to support Kiss the Ground when you learn with Humble Bundle.

item.title: Gamer's Kitchen Cookbooks by Insight Editions
item.description: Games have never looked so delicious
item.content:encoded: Cook your way through your favorite games with this bundle of official and unofficial video game recipe books! Fry up tasty street food and mix some criminally delicious cocktails with An Unofficial Grand Theft Auto Cookbook! Fill up on sweetrolls and brew an apple cabbage stew any tavern keeper would envy with The Elder Scrolls: The Official Cookbook! Quench your thirst with the Wasteland-inspired libations in Fallout: The Official Drinks Book! Throw a gamer dinner party or cook up a multi-course meal for one with the 27 recipe books included in this collection! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support NatureBridge with your purchase!

item.title: The Ultimate Gene Wolfe Library by Tor Books
item.description: New suns, ancient lands, and beyond
item.content:encoded: Sci-fi and fantasy master Gene Wolfe’s novels and long-running series span all facets of genre fiction, each one unlike anything else ever written. For anyone looking to get into one of the greats, we’ve partnered with Tor Books to bring you the best of Gene Wolfe in one massive library! Enter the world of the genre-bending Book of the New Sun series with the Dying Earth fantasy of Shadow and Claw! Travel back to Ancient Greece with an amnesiac mercenary manipulated by the gods in Soldier of the Mist! Meet a young boy destined to become a warrior and more in the mythology remix The Knight! Nearly 40 novels, short story collections, and more are featured in this truly giant bundle, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Alzheimer’s Research UK with your purchase!

item.title: Dark Places and Endless Night: Sheer Horror by IDW
item.content:encoded: The days are getting colder, the nights are getting longer, and spooky season is officially upon us. Lean into the scary vibes with this bundle of horror comics and graphic novels from IDW! Explore an idyllic small town of anthropomorphic animals protected by a serial killer bear in the Richard Scarry-esque murder mystery Beneath the Trees Where Nobody Sees! Follow an all-women crew of inmate firefighters as they stage a heist during a rampaging California wildfire in the first of Scott Snyder’s anthology series Dark Spaces: Wildfire! Discover the truth of a strange sleeping illness in the graphic novel adaptation of Stephen and Owen King’s Sleeping Beauties! Survive the bloody horrors of the vampire-infested Alaska town in the Deluxe Edition of 30 Days of Night! All of these and more are included in this spooky bundle of horror comics, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support BINC with your purchase!

item.title: Crochet Bags and Wearables by Open Road Media
item.content:encoded: Fill your closet with crochet wearables with this library of craft ebooks from Open Road Media! This collection of crochet patterns and inspiration includes 29 books with ideas for basically everything—from shawls, hats, handbags, and adorable animal slippers to southwest-inspired blankets and cozy cardigans. If you’re intimidated by any of the more complex patterns, there are also plenty of simple projects for beginners you can finish in a few hours! Next time you need some inspiration for an ambitious project or just something to do with your hands in your idle time, let these crochet books be your guide! Get all 29 books for the price of your choice, and support the Breast Cancer Research Foundation with your purchase!

item.title: Cybersecurity Month 2026 by O'Reilly
item.description: Fortify your digital worlds with elite cybersecurity.
item.content:encoded: Online scams and malware are everywhere in 2026—what are you doing to protect yourself? Prevent security breaches before they happen with the techniques and tools from the Humble Tech Book Bundle: Cybersecurity Month by O’Reilly. Top titles from this curated library include Learning Cloud Security and Software Supply Chain Security. Learn software supply chain security and DevSecOps, build an original cyber risk management program, and more. Pay what you want to gain essential digital defense skills and help support Code for America with your purchase.

item.title: Gatchaman and Speed Racer by Mad Cave Studios
item.description: Catch up with Speed Racer & friends!
item.content:encoded: Dive into an all‑new interpretation of Tatsuo Yoshida’s classic manga series, Speed Racer, with our latest comics bundle! Follow the adventures of Speed, Trixie, Pops, Spritle, and Chim Chim as they race to save the day in the iconic symbol of speed and gadgetry—the Mach Five. Discover the high‑speed action of this timeless franchise! And, if that’s not enough adventure for you, we’ve included the iconic Gatchaman series for the ultimate teamup! Both legendary series are in one awesome bundle—plus, your purchase helps support the Make‑A‑Wish Foundation.

item.title: Joe Haldeman: The Forever War and Beyond by Open Road Media
item.description: The future worlds of Joe Haldeman
item.content:encoded: Meet one of the masters of science fiction in this collection of books by the one and only Joe Haldeman! See where it all started with his Nebula, Hugo, and Locus Award winning novel The Forever War, a drama of civilizations trapped in interstellar conflict! Embark on a nailbiting trip to the surface of a future Earth threatened by a terrorist plot in Worlds! Follow an intergalactic spy wracked with guilt over dangerous missions in All My Sins Remembered! There’s even more to explore in this bundle of 17 of Joe Haldeman’s greatest sci-fi stories, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support Active Minds charity with your purchase!

item.title: The Best of Brian W. Aldiss by Open Road Media
item.description: Sci-fi like you’ve never seen it before
item.content:encoded: Far off worlds! Dangerous Edens! The future of humanity and beyond! Read the works of a true master of science fiction with this massive bundle of ebooks by Brian W. Aldiss! Visit a planet with seasons that last for centuries and civilizations in constant conflict in Helliconia Spring! Discover the secrets behind a mad scientist’s beastly creations in An Island Called Moreau! Follow a utopian Mars colony as they fight to survive against insurmountable odds in Finches of Mars! All of these adventures and more are included in this bundle of over 40 fantastic ebooks by a true master of the genre. Get them now at the price of your choosing, and support Active Minds charity with your purchase!

item.title: C++ Programming Masterclass: Code Faster. Build Smarter. Master C++
item.description: In sync with the C++ Programming Masterclass
item.content:encoded: Learn the ultimate high-performance, general-purpose programming language with our C++ Programming Masterclass of ebooks curated by the experts at Packt. C++ supports multiple programming paradigms—including procedural, object-oriented, and generic programming—making it the perfect starting point for your journey as a developer. Gain practical knowledge from top-rated titles like Bare-Metal Embedded C Programming, C++ Memory Management, and the Modern C++ Programming Cookbook without ever stepping foot in a classroom. Code faster, build smarter with C++ and help support The Global FoodBanking Network today!

item.title: Batman Day Comics Bundle by DC Comics
item.content:encoded:
Own the night alongside the Caped Crusader with the Batman Day Comics Bundle 2026! Pay what you want for a catalog of modern classics by the biggest Batman artists and writers like Dan Watters, Scott Snyder, and Nick Dragotta. Read the Bat's action‑packed comics, including Batman: Dark Patterns, Batman Vol. 1–10 (2011–2016), and Absolute Batman Vol. 1: The Zoo. Bring your imagination and celebrate Batman Day on September 19th with the Dark Knight’s greatest adventures, and help support the BINC Foundation with your purchase!

Redeemed on GlobalComix. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate before October 10th, 2027. Titles are not available for download off of GlobalComix.

item.title: 50 Essential Fantagraphics Titles by Fantagraphics
item.content:encoded: A classic alien invasion thriller! An iconic Sunday strip adventure! A murder investigation with a pulpy twist! When it comes to publishing great comics, Fantagraphics knows what’s up, and if you’ve been looking to get into what this fantastic publisher has to offer, we’ve collected 50 of Fantagraphics’ best titles in one bundle! Solve the murder of a mysterious woman alongside a horror-obsessed 10-year-old in My Favorite Thing Is Monsters! Escape to an era of medieval swordfights and epic adventures with the first two collected volumes of Prince Valiant! Fight back against a devastating alien invasion in the subversive Argentine masterwork The Eternaut! All of these and many more are featured in this bundle of 50—yes, F-I-F-T-Y—of Fantagraphics’ best titles, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support the Freedom of the Press Foundation with your purchase!

item.title: Kurt Busiek's Astro City: The 30th Anniversary by Image Comics
item.content:encoded: Celebrate multi‑time Eisner and Harvey Award winner author Kurt Busiek’s most popular works with The 30th Anniversary Bundle by Image Comics! Lose yourself in the complete Astro City series! How do average people, support teams, and even villains navigate day‑to‑day life in a world where being truly super is possible—read volumes 1‑17 and see what makes Astro City so unforgettable. Or explore The Autumnlands, an epic tale that melds mature themes with high‑fantasy wizardry! Pay what you want for critically acclaimed comics and help support The BINC Foundation with your purchase!

item.title: Legend In The Mist & :Otherscape RPG Collection by Son of Oak
item.description: High fantasies, tech dystopias, and beyond
item.content:encoded:
If you’ve been looking to expand your tabletop gaming horizons, look no further than this bundle of rulebooks, resource guides, and adventures set in two of the fantastical worlds of publisher Son of Oak! Brave the wilds of story-driven rustic fantasy TTRPG Legend in the Mist, an adventure steeped in folktales and magic! Or look to the future with cyberpunk fantasy Metro:Otherscape, where spirits and gods grant powers to tech-addled mortals! This bundle includes everything you need to start your campaign in either (or both!) RPG, from setting manuals to maps, character packs, soundtracks, and more! Dive into a new realm of adventure by grabbing this bundle at the price of your choice, and support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

Codes are redeemable through the DriveThruRPG website.

item.title: AI in Production: Governance, Reliability, and Application by Manning
item.description: Streamline your production environments with AI
item.content:encoded: Master the governance, reliability, and application of AI tools in a production setting with our latest learning bundle by Manning! Learn how to safely and efficiently deploy large language model applications with LLMs in Production, access a practical playbook for deploying secure, responsible, and compliant Generative AI systems with AI Governance (MEAP), or help users locate what they need with accuracy from AI Powered Search. Save big on vital lessons on AI in production and help support Feeding America with your purchase!

item.title: The Best of C.J. Cherryh by Daw Books
item.content:encoded: Traverse planets, galaxies, and whole universes of adventure and mystery in this bundle of award-winning author C.J. Cherryh’s best novels! Start with her Hugo Award-winning sci-fi novel Downbelow Station, set on a backwater planet and its space station caught in the middle of an intergalactic war! Dive into the author’s classic (and extensive) space opera series full of assassination, mystery, and interspecies intrigue with Foreigner 10th Anniversary Edition! Take her high fantasy classics for a spin with all four books of The Complete Morgaine, following a woman tasked with saving the very fabric of reality from an ancient network of portals! There’s so much more to explore in this bundle of 30+ sci-fi and fantasy ebooks from one of the greatest working authors of our time, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support BINC with your purchase!
